doc.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing thanks
summary: Brown thanks Gordon on behalf of the Smithsonian and the conversation ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I want to say on behalf of Ken and the Smithsonian Institution, and I would say every jazz aficionado, we want to thank you, Lorraine Gordon, for keeping jazz alive.

Ah, that’s so sweet. I never thought about it, but I’m glad you have, and it makes me feel good that I wasn’t alone over this long trip. Wow. It’s been a long one. But a good one. But thank you. I’m totally honored and almost speechless—but not quite.
